Record.title: Record
Record.description: A school schedule mapping record representing a school user profile, teacher, class, subject, or teaching assignment.

name.description: Name or code of the school, teacher, class, subject, or level (Tahap 1, 2, 3).

username.description: School full name (for user type) or parent school ID reference.

role.description: School password (for user), class teacher ID (for class), Tahap 1 period count (for subject), or Tahun (Tahun 1-6 for level).

subject.description: Teacher short code (for teacher) or Tahap 2 period count (for subject).

maxHours.description: Maximum weekly teaching hours (periods) for a teacher.

level.description: Class level classification (Tahap 1, Tahap 2, or Tahap 3).

class_id.description: Assigned class ID for an assignment record.

subject_id.description: Assigned subject ID for an assignment record.

teacher_id.description: Assigned teacher ID for an assignment record.

/records/{recordId}.description: Stores all school schedule mapping records (schools, teachers, classes, subjects, and assignments) synced across all devices.
